line_items.description: Custom Neon LED Sign ('DEBUGS ARE FEATURES') for Hackathon Lounge
Gaffer Tape Industrial Matte Black (50m roll)
Mini Desktop Zen Gardens with Branded Wooden Rakes (Pack of 15)
Emergency USB-C to Serial DB9 FTDI Adapter Cable (2m)

reasoning: Commercial invoice for hackathon goods. The note names the event but does not state that a budget owner pre-approved the purchase, so Chapter 10 requires deduction of the custom neon sign and branded zen-garden giveaways as event signage and promotional materials. The generic gaffer tape is a routine consumable and is reimbursable up to the 50.00 per-invoice office-supplies cap. The USB-C serial adapters cost 24.95 each, below the 100.00 peripheral threshold, so their 49.90 line is reimbursable. Reimbursable net is 99.90 and its 19% VAT is 18.98. Total reimbursement is 118.88.
